title: NASA EO: A Shift in What's Shaping U.S. Landscapes — Landsat 35년 분석, Nature Geoscience
snippet: NASA-funded study published in Nature Geoscience analyzed nearly 35 years of Landsat satellite data. Wild disturbances (wildfires, hurricanes) are increasing while human-directed disturbances (logging, agricultural expansion, construction) have declined. Machine-learning algorithm trained on 40 years of land-change data at 50,000 locations achieves 75%+ accuracy across most disturbance types.
